description: This Dart source file defines the AccountsRepository class, which manages a list of Account objects using local storage via SharedPreferences. It provides methods to load, save, and update account balances, utilizing shared preferences for persistence and modeling account data with the Account class.

classes.name: AccountsRepository
classes.description: Manages account data using local JSON storage; provides methods to load, save, and update accounts.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the list of accounts from persistent storage; seeds with mock data if none exists.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the provided list of accounts to persistent storage.

methods.name: updateBalance
methods.description: Updates the balance of a specific account by ID and saves the changes.
